title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Plat-Arch-205 exam
question:
If a Case requires involvement from one of the Legal team, the Case owner adds one of the corporate lawyers to the Legal SME field on the case.
Since cases are private, how can we grant a lawyer access to a specific case when their assistance is needed?
option_A: Create a Criteria Based Sharing Rule that shares to the Legal Public Group when the "legal assistance needed?" field is checked.
option_B: Use Apex Managed sharing in a case Trigger that shares the record to the user identified in the Legal SME field.
option_C: Create an Criteria Based Sharing Rule that shares to the Corporate Legal Tear Role when the "legal assistance needed?" field is checked.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Plat-Arch-205 exam
question:
The sales managers at Universal Containers requested their teams to define each user's role on their accounts in order to provide an easy way to establish accountability and collaboration. Sales managers also requested that sales associates should only get the following permissions: 1. Read access to the accounts. 2. Read access to cases related to the accounts. 3. No access to deals related to the accounts.
The sales associates may be granted access to opportunities when needed.
Assuming the overall sharing model of the organization is Private and no sharing rules are configured on the Account object, how should an architect achieve these requirements?
option_A: Use Account teams and sharing rules to share cases with sales associates. No change required to the Opportunity object.
option_B: Use Account teams and Case teams. No configuration required for the Opportunity object.
option_C: Use Account teams to define access to accounts as well as opportunities and cases related to accounts.
